key.name: show-in-panel
key.description: Display the currently sung line of lyrics inside the GNOME Shell Top Bar.

key.name: show-floating
key.description: Display the floating multi-line lyrics HUD overlay on the desktop.

key.name: floating-always-on-top
key.description: Keep the floating lyrics HUD above standard application windows.

key.name: floating-click-passthrough
key.description: Make the floating HUD non-reactive so mouse clicks pass through to windows beneath.

key.name: floating-position
key.description: Pre-configured screen placement or custom draggable coordinates.

key.name: floating-x
key.description: Custom X position on the primary monitor in pixels.

key.name: floating-y
key.description: Custom Y position on the primary monitor in pixels.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family name for rendering lyrics text.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Base font size for floating lyrics in pixels.

key.name: line-spacing
key.description: Vertical spacing between lyric lines in pixels.

key.name: background-style
key.description: Visual background treatment for the floating HUD overlay.

key.name: enable-spicy-lyrics
key.description: Fetch Apple Music syllable-synced lyrics from Spicy Lyrics API when enabled.

key.name: spicy-lyrics-token
key.description: Spotify Web access token for authenticating with Spicy Lyrics API.

key.name: enable-romanization
key.description: Transliterate Korean Hangul, Japanese Kana, and Cyrillic scripts to Latin.
